summary.value: A flashback to 2006 and 2007, when Satoru Gojo and Suguru Geto were students at Tokyo Jujutsu High. The pair, the strongest duo in the school, are assigned to escort a girl who is meant to be merged with the barrier-keeper Tengen, and the escort is targeted by the assassin Toji Zenin.
A year later, Geto's growing doubts about protecting people who cannot see curses push him to a decision that sets the two friends on different paths.

events.title: A mission ends up on the news
events.detail: Gojo forgets to raise a curtain and the school has to answer for it.

events.title: The Star Plasma Vessel
events.detail: Gojo and Geto are told to protect Riko Amanai and to grant her wishes in her last days.

events.title: A contract on her life
events.detail: Toji Zenin is hired to kill her, and he plans around Gojo's strengths.

events.title: The escort ends in tragedy
events.detail: An ambush leaves both students shaken and changes how they see their work.

events.title: Geto's decision
events.detail: A year later he can no longer reconcile the work with how he feels about non-sorcerers.
